issues.desc: background.md Solution Tradeoffs / Conversational Texture sections reference the cross-story id B-2aa7 three times (lines 3, 11, 15) without ever giving it an explicit one-sentence gloss on first appearance (e.g. "B-2aa7 = the prior red-evidence validation hardening story"). A fresh reader can reconstruct roughly what B-2aa7 was from surrounding technical narrative about red-b2aa7-* receipts, chk007, and derived-vs-fixed-enumeration checks, but the reference itself is never explained in one sentence as CLAUDE.md guidance recommends for cross-story references.
